name: Reactive Resume (Legacy)
tagline: A free and open-source resume builder
description: A free and open-source resume builder that simplifies the process of creating, updating, and sharing your resume.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-reactive-resume application
services:
  # Main application
  app:
    container_name: big-bear-reactive-resume
    image: amruthpillai/reactive-resume:v5.3.2@sha256:b433dbe2fa2c23bfb7734d16380e4d703a05349db096113a18cb13b16f4c1fa0
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - minio
      - redis
      - chrome
    networks:
      - reactive-resume-network
    environment:
      # -- Environment Variables --
      PORT: "3000"
      NODE_ENV: "production"
      # -- URLs --
      PUBLIC_URL: "http://[CASAOS_IP]:3000"
      STORAGE_URL: "http://[CASAOS_IP]:9000/default"
      # -- Printer (Chrome) --
      CHROME_TOKEN: ${SECRET_CHROME_TOKEN}
      CHROME_URL: "ws://chrome:3000"
      # -- Database (Postgres) --
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/postgres"
      # -- Auth --
      ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET: ${SECRET_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET}
      REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET: ${SECRET_REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET}
      # -- Emails --
      MAIL_FROM: "noreply@localhost"
      # SMTP_URL: smtp://user:pass@smtp:587 # Optional

      # -- Storage (Minio) --
      STORAGE_ENDPOINT: "[CASAOS_IP]"
      STORAGE_PORT: "9000"
      STORAGE_REGION: "us-east-1" # Optional
      STORAGE_BUCKET: "default"
      STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY: ${SECRET_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY}
      STORAGE_SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY}
      STORAGE_USE_SSL: "false"
      # -- Cache (Redis) --
      REDIS_URL: "redis://default:password@redis:6379"
      # -- Sentry --
      # VITE_SENTRY_DSN: https://id.sentry.io # Optional
  # -- Crowdin (Optional) --
  # CROWDIN_PROJECT_ID:
  # CROWDIN_PERSONAL_TOKEN:

  # -- Email (Optional) --
  # DISABLE_EMAIL_AUTH: true
  # VITE_DISABLE_SIGNUPS: true

  # -- GitHub (Optional) --
  # GITHUB_CLIENT_ID: "github_client_id"
  # GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET: "github_client_secret"
  # GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL: "http://[CASAOS_IP]:3000/api/auth/github/callback"

  # -- Google (Optional) --
  # GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: "google_client_id"
  # GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: "google_client_secret"
  # GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL: "http://[CASAOS_IP]:3000/api/auth/google/callback"

  # Database (Postgres)
  postgres:
    container_name: big-bear-reactive-resume-db
    image: postgres:15-alpine@sha256:3d0f7584ed7d04e27fa050d6683a74746608faf21f202be78460d679cc56461f
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/pg/data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: "postgres"
      POSTGRES_USER: "postgres"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "postgres"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d postgres"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - reactive-resume-network
  # Storage (for image uploads)
  minio:
    container_name: big-bear-reactive-resume-minio
    image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2024-09-13T20-26-02Z-cpuv1@sha256:a34ac7cbc53154bef4804b1f9d83a555f944d8c26e6466cef7e782fdb5ec40c4
    command: ["server", "/data"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - 9000:9000
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/minio/data:/data
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: "minioadmin"
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY}
    networks:
      - reactive-resume-network
  # Chrome Browser (for printing and previews)
  chrome:
    container_name: big-bear-reactive-resume-chrome
    image: browserless/chrome:1.61.1-puppeteer-21.4.1@sha256:b6acad3ef2e1e0e3c2eb018add533570db2b34f5304682bad58c803b23ef7bd2
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      TOKEN: ${SECRET_CHROME_TOKEN}
      EXIT_ON_HEALTH_FAILURE: "true"
      PRE_REQUEST_HEALTH_CHECK: "true"
    networks:
      - reactive-resume-network
  # Redis (for cache & server session management)
  redis:
    container_name: big-bear-reactive-resume-redis
    image: redis:8.2.2-alpine@sha256:1c78f5e7512cc8b22b0edc95c20e7abd9e1fd832e5dfd5c3c6b59ce82fb238d0
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--requirepass", "password"]
    networks:
      - reactive-resume-network
# Networks used by the application
networks:
  # Define the network for AdGuard Home
  reactive-resume-network:
    driver: bridge
